name: format
description: Format the provided file by adding annotations, comments and adhering to the style guide
prompt_template:
Modfiy the Python file by adding comments, type annotations and adhering to the style guide provided below: {{args}}

Steps:
1. Use file_read to read the contents of the file.
2. Identify every function definition (def ...) that is missing type annotations on its parameters or return type.
3. Use file_write to write the updated file back to the same path, with type annotations added.
4. Add descriptive header comments to each function, overwriting the previous if it exists. Each header comment should be of the format:'''
<description>
<parameters: followed by the name and explaination of each parameter>
<Returns:explain what us returned>'''
5. Reformat the code without writing or changing it so that:
(1) Each indent is precisely one tab,
(2)Dictionaries, function calls and comprehensions are formatted in multiple lines with no trailing comma for the final element,
(3)Lines immedately requiring indents after them have a preceding one line space above them.
6. Do not change any logic or write new code. 
7. If anything is ambiguous such as the type, go with the most specific level of specificity that you are certain of.
6. Confirm what changes were made.
